sourceLevelGains.scope: Whole-source removal source and acquired conditional actor
sourceLevelGains.finding: The current wizard.arch.dispel-magic card is bound at /cards/19. The exact preserved Wizard20 actor selected it at class level9, within the source schedule, and lists it as always prepared. This is evidenced conditional actor acquisition, not an assumed or campaign acquisition. The current source card and preserved chosen card are identical. Fortress is an ongoing rank9 spell Until Dispelled, not a permanent artifact property.

sourceLevelGains.finding: Exact accepted AC5 Humanoid Champion and Elemental Fire Pet profiles, finite source ending, intrinsic manifestation disappearance, real borrowed-object survival, and command/phase rules are bound. AC5-X17 is an accepted Elemental Banishment comparison only. No automatic transfer to Fortress, campaign occurrence or corpse creation follows.

sourceLevelGains.finding: The preserved Wizard20 selected Arcane Recovery. Its source restores half Wizard class level rounded up, capped by actual RP maximum, once between long rests on completion of a legitimate short rest. At Wizard20 the source amount is10RP; no recovery occurs merely from entering Fortress.
sourceLevelGains.stillMissing: Actually eligible uninterrupted rest interval, safety/supplies and previous rest/use history, clocks, and exactly authorized recovery settlement without double-counting another recovery source.

sourceLevelGains.finding: Panel AC/HP, bounded rooms/doors/stairs, persistent nonconcentrating Until-Dispelled source, creator-death independence and terminal policy were already explicitly selected NEW local authorship. These rules are not missing source discoveries. Their support graph and required integrated consequences remain untested.

Bind a real acquired attack/effect whose actual target rule allows the selected structure/object; record geometry, payment, attack/save/damage inputs, HP and dependent support effects. A profile damage number or creature-only Arcane Bolt does not establish object-target legality. No new canonical source is required for the already-authored layout itself.

Keep the same nonconcentrating Fortress source/space/entrance/imports operating; preserve lost personal control and access under their rules. No invented lethal spell or death outcome.

remainingWitnessParts.minimumWitness: Demonstrate actual operator/traveler Actions, granted authority, fixed entrance identity, fit/crossing/movement costs, closed-door behavior and interior exit-control glyph used by an occupant. Include denial or actual obstruction/suppression without free relocation, hidden permission oracle or denied costs refunded.

remainingWitnessParts.remainingGap: No Arch Dispel is paid, targeted, checked or resolved.
remainingWitnessParts.minimumWitness: Use the verified selected Wizard20 card. Establish perception of the ongoing Fortress effect, within60ft under applicable plane/line-of-effect rules; record available Action,3RP base plus any actual source-defined modifiers, ready recharge and live magic/strain/cast history. Commit and record any genuine interruption/counter window with only actually present eligible responders. INT20 gives+5 and PB6 gives+11: explicit conditional face8 totals19 (success), face7 totals18 (failure). These arithmetic checks here are not rolled encounters. Success ends the one rank9 root and settles every extant occupant/item under Fortress terminal rules; failure leaves it active. Both paid attempts spend the Action/cost and start Recharge2; tick only actual later regular STARTs2→1→0. No Action refresh at END or refund.

remainingWitnessParts.remainingGap: No field is created or overlapped with occupied structural support.
remainingWitnessParts.minimumWitness: Bind a real eligible Antimagic/Null source and acquired actor, payment/source duration, exact boundary and occupied structural intersection. Fortress-local Q27 then ends the whole source and settles contents; do not pause absent support, grant floating floors or import an arbitrary global Null rule. Distinguish suppressed entrance-only behavior from occupied structural-region suppression.

remainingWitnessParts.remainingGap: No actual panel destruction/dependent collapse or Falling occurs.

Structural loss alone does not automatically evacuate everyone or end the root.

On actual whole-source closure, process death/reversion first, then corpse and cargo placement/conflict without revival, deletion or original-body duplication. AC5 expired summons provide no corpse.

At expiry remove the body/intrinsic gear, preserve real loose cargo; later source ending returns that cargo once under Fortress policy. No new corpse, loot, refill or changed summon clock.

remainingWitnessParts.remainingGap: No acquired operative form, equipment mapping or actual reversion precedes closure.
remainingWitnessParts.minimumWitness: Bind the exact current form source/profile/acquisition, paid activation and original body/resource/equipment mapping, expiry/end/suppression trigger and restored current anatomy. Apply real reversion before terminal fit; use the current size/body for placement and retain any exact placement conflict. No invented form profile or restored spent resources.

remainingWitnessParts.remainingGap: The surviving nested source entrance/anchor relationship is not settled by generic parent cleanup.
remainingWitnessParts.minimumWitness: Name the independently acquired nested-space source and its exact entry/anchor/ending contract. Resolve whether it ends with children settled before parent or survives with a source-authorized relocated/settled entrance. Bind parent/child IDs, anchors, all contents and independent costs/deadlines. The preserved Wizard20 has Dimensional Pocket/Arcane Sanctuary capabilities, but availability alone does not authorize a surviving anchor relocation.
